reason: A web UI plugin for previewing and attaching dropped files, storing them in a browser file box, capturing desktop screenshots, and optionally sending images to a configured vision model for text recognition.

summaries.zh: 用于在网页界面中拖放预览并管理文件、渲染 Markdown、截取桌面画面，以及将图片发送到已配置的识图模型进行文字识别。
summaries.en: A web UI plugin for previewing and managing dropped files, rendering Markdown, capturing desktop screenshots, and optionally sending images to a configured vision model for text recognition.

capabilities: Reads files and folders dropped into the web interface
Previews images, Markdown, text, and code files
Copies attachments into the session workspace
Persists selected files and screenshots in browser IndexedDB
Captures full-screen, selected-region, and window screenshots through operating-system tools
Sends screenshots or images to a configured external vision model for transcription or summarization
Creates Markdown text files containing recognition results
